syntax.$description: Code syntax roles. A highlighter is the one place where hue carries meaning that cannot be expressed as a surface/text pair, so — like the categorical chart series — these are their own semantic vocabulary rather than reuses of text.* roles. Calm, professional hues for code inside enterprise applications — not an IDE neon theme. Every role, punctuation and comments included, is ≥4.5:1 on the code surface.
